about_the_game:
This is a tabletop card war game set in the world of Cthulhu Mythos.

Players choose a controlling deity and receive a starting deck of cards from that deity.

Basic Gameplay:

Each turn, you choose a card to play. Playing cards is influenced by your Faith.

Cards are categorized as follows:

Building Cards: Using building cards, you can construct buildings belonging to your faction on the tabletop map. Each building has its own unique function.

Hint Cards: Playing hint cards grants you special actions.

Role Cards: Whether constructing and using buildings, or participating in hint actions, you need a character card.

Main Deity Skills:

Each deity possesses unique skills that require players to complete. Completing these skills rewards players with rewards, while failing them results in penalties.

Character Skills:

Each character possesses skills, each with its own passive effects.

Protagonist:

During game battles, you will unexpectedly encounter the protagonist of this tabletop world. Completing their quests allows you to experience their story and watch them grow.

Trial Version Content:

In the trial version, players can only choose one god to experience the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: IntelCore i3
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: This is a tabletop card war game based on the worldview of Cthulhu Mythos. Players can choose to play one of the three gods and win the game through their own will.
